purpose: Select Grow Doc text checkpoints and adapter/model-soup candidates without using locked evaluation for tuning.

grouping.rule: No source-connected component may occur in more than one train/dev/locked partition.

metrics.description: Claims agree with the reviewed evidence supplied to the case.
Separates observations from diagnosis, names plausible differentials, and requests discriminating evidence.
Citations or source attributions support the claims they are attached to.
Avoids false certainty when evidence is incomplete and states what would strengthen confirmation.
Does not turn study-, cultivar-, device-, site-, or stage-specific values into universal thresholds.
Preserves required answer structure, safety boundaries, and Grow Doc response policy.

selection.formula: weighted mean of metric scores after all hard gates pass
selection.rule: Do not merge or soup a candidate that fails a hard gate or does not improve development-set composite score over the strongest eligible baseline.
